summary.one_liner: Arcane is a modern Docker management web UI, described in its README as "Modern Docker Management, Designed for Everyone."
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short and mostly points elsewhere: setup, configuration, and development guides live on an official documentation site. It states that feature requests go to GitHub Discussions and that Issues are reserved for bug reports. It links to a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) for transparency and to a Crowdin page for translations. It does not list specific features, supported platforms, or install commands in the README itself. The listing in the awesome-selfhost-docker collection places it under Development as a Docker management UI.
use_cases: manage docker containers through a web interface
review docker host software bill of materials
notable: Provides a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) for transparency, published at getarcane.app/sbom
Feature requests handled via GitHub Discussions; Issues reserved for bug reports
caveats: README is minimal; setup and configuration details are only on the external documentation site
No install or run commands are given in the README
